style_block: Full-bleed edge-to-edge image filling the entire frame, no borders, no panel frame, no margins, no side bars. Cinematic film still, 35mm look, slightly desaturated teal-and-amber color grade, soft haze, gentle film grain, subtle sci-fi details (faint double reflections, a frozen passer-by), real Porto and Lisbon locations rendered accurately. The person in the reference photo is the main character: keep their face, hair, skin tone and glasses/beard clearly recognizable, same character in every image. The main character is inside the scene, mid-action, face visible but never a posed portrait. Recurring motifs where the scene allows: a yellow umbrella, a grey raincoat, a single orange. Mysterious and uncanny, never horror, no blood, no weapons. No text, no logos, no watermarks, no speech bubbles, no captions, no subtitles, no text anywhere in the image. Vertical 3:4 portrait framing, main character shown head to knees filling the tall frame, scene composed vertically. No clocks or watches are visible unless the scene explicitly asks for one; if one appears it is tiny and heavily blurred, with no readable hands or numerals. Screens, newspapers and signs are blank or unreadable.
outfit: a dark olive-green jacket over a white t-shirt, dark jeans, white sneakers, a small brown crossbody bag (no yellow anywhere on the main character; yellow is reserved for Dona Graça's umbrella)
